notes:
Background: mid-market SaaS (collaborative docs) — product team evaluating adding semantic search to power "quick-find" and recommendations. Initially interested in Hosted API for quick rollout, moving to Dedicated if throughput/cost requirements met.

POC ask: 2-week eval. Index ~12M short-doc records (avg 600 tokens), batch reindex nightly via Airflow; embed-time windowed updates (delta ingestion). Target query throughput 200–300 qps peak, 95th percentile nearest-neighbor latency <120ms (vector lookup + embedding generation).

Preference: integrate with Pinecone in prod but want Redwood to show managed routing to Pinecone-compatible index OR host embeddings and vector index within Dedicated (cost/latency tradeoff). Mentioned Milvus for eventual on-prem experiments for regulated customers.

Security/compliance: SSO (SAML) required, SOC2 attestation mandatory, strong audit logs for indexing/queries, optional KMS integration. Data residency: EU customers must keep content in eu-west region.

Key product asks from PM/Eng:
- Ability to batch embed via bulk endpoints (Airflow job) and monitor token usage per-run.
- Incremental reindex API with conflict handling and idempotency.
- Vector metadata filters (multifield) + multi-model fallback routing (cheap model for low-confidence rerank).
- Cost predictability for embeddings: committed throughput pricing for Dedicated vs per-embed tokens on Hosted.

- "We need predictable egress and predictable cost for our enterprise customers — per-token surprises mean we can't sell committed SLAs." — Head of Platform (Alex R.).
- "If Redwood can demo <120ms at 250 qps on 12M vectors in Dedicated, we can justify the migration from Pinecone." — Senior SWE (Maya).

- Showed Optimize recommendations for batching parameters; SE suggested quantized embeddings on Dedicated to reduce memory footprint.
- Team asked for sample Airflow DAG and example bulk ingest via SDK (Nina to deliver).

Commercial: initial pricing ask sent 03/09 — looking for committed monthly throughput tiers and a break-even comparison vs Pinecone + OpenAI. Finance wants a modeled 12-month TCO.
